2.evidence: close-automation fully replicable with ERP APIs + FM agents; no proprietary ML needed

3.evidence: 'automated recon for 3 GL accounts' tiny sellable scope

4.evidence: ERP integration standard (NetSuite/SAP APIs); 'without uprooting ERPs' per article

5.evidence: client GL data accessible via ERP APIs

7.evidence: weeks-months to first automated close cycle

9.evidence: 'SOX-ready close automation' package crisp and demoable

10.evidence: monthly close = literally recurring by definition - ideal retainer cadence

11.evidence: recon/close playbooks white-label across clients beautifully

13.evidence: agents need review loops but manageable

15.evidence: days-shaved-off-close + audit-prep cost anchors direct and provable

17.evidence: accounting ops budgets universal across mid-market

20.evidence: controllers/CFOs reachable directly - classic agency buyer

22.evidence: article: Redpoint, Kleiner Perkins, Audacious; BlackLine/Rubrik operator angels

26.evidence: article: early clients Scale AI, SpotOn, Rippling - strong proof

27.evidence: every mid-market controller in the country is a reachable lead

28.evidence: workflow IP shallow-moderate; domain rules matter more than ML

32.evidence: SOX alignment is process discipline not licensing

38.evidence: close-days/recon-error metrics provable every single month

43.evidence: accounting literacy required - learnable, common in agencies

44.evidence: BlackLine/FloQast entrenchment at enterprise; mid-market open

45.evidence: ERP vendors ship native AI gradually - coexistence likely

46.evidence: automation patterns copy fast; execution quality differentiates

47.evidence: monthly close forever = perfect recurring revenue

51.evidence: before/after close-timeline demos visceral for CFOs

52.evidence: Scale/Rippling references + operator angels = warm leads

agency_play.build_scope: Partial functionality: agentic month-end-close kits for mid-market finance teams - auto-reconciliation bots, JE drafting with human approval gates, close checklists with variance flags on ERP APIs + FM agents - Maxima's exact wedge without the platform.
agency_play.packaging: Productized 'Close-in-Days' program per entity: recon automation + SOX evidence pack; monthly close-ops retainer thereafter.
agency_play.pricing: Implementation $30-70k per entity; retainer $4-10k/mo per close cycle.
agency_play.first_clients: $20M-$500M revenue companies with 3-5 day closes, spreadsheet-heavy recons, and audit-prep fire drills.
